items.q: What's the difference between ModularIoT and traditional telematics providers?
items.a: Traditional providers stop at alerting: they notify you and that's it. ModularIoT interprets every symptom, assigns an owner and a plan, and measures whether the deviation actually drops month over month. On top of that, your data and processing logic stay under your control, with no per-asset pricing lock-in. It's the difference between alerting and reducing.

items.q: How does ModularIoT compare to Apache Kafka or Apache Pulsar?
items.a: Kafka and Pulsar are excellent message brokers; ModularIoT is a complete fleet data processing platform. We use Pulsar under the hood, but we add fleet-specific processors, detection rules and ready-to-use integrations. Enterprise-grade streaming without building everything from scratch.

items.q: Do I need to change my current technology?
items.a: No. We integrate with the sensors, GPS, cameras and systems you already have installed. During the diagnostic we review your current technology and confirm compatibility.

items.q: What about GDPR and data sovereignty?
items.a: Data sovereignty is a core principle: all processing happens in your chosen region/cloud, and we never store your fleet's data in our systems. We include anonymization, retention policies and audit trails. Your data stays under your control at all times.

items.q: How fast can we get started?
items.a: For managed deployments, you can be processing live data within 48 hours. On-your-cloud deployments typically take 1-2 weeks, including infrastructure setup and integration testing.

items.q: Does the system generate a lot of alerts the team ends up ignoring?
items.a: That's exactly what we avoid. Alerts have smart exclusion rules: no notification is generated unless it meets the conditions configured for your operation. Your operators only see what matters and requires action.

items.q: What kind of support do you offer?
items.a: All plans include technical support through our portal. Higher-tier plans include a dedicated Customer Success Manager and priority response times, up to 24/7 support with guaranteed SLAs.
